name: PSW Practice Test
fullName: Ontario Personal Support Worker (PSW) final exam
outlineComment: Ontario Personal Support Worker program standard, January 2022 (Ministry of Colleges and Universities, code 41469; 14 vocational learning outcomes), used by colleges, career colleges and school boards and by the NACC PSW final exam. The 14 VLOs are grouped into 8 categories; neither the Ministry nor NACC publishes per-outcome exam weights, so counts are ours. Law is current Ontario law: Fixing Long-Term Care Act, 2021 (replaced the LTCHA 2007 named in the standard), Retirement Homes Act, 2010, Health Care Consent Act, 1996, PHIPA 2004, RHPA 1991, OHSA. 70% is a readiness line, not an official pass mark. All items original.
